model: BREITLING Superocean Heritage Automatic 42 AB2010121B1A1 (42 mm steel, black dial, steel mesh bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Follower of the Breitling Superocean 42 template (ceramic-insert dive bezel inside a steel coin-edge ring, no crown guards here) with its own measurements: arrow-head hour hand, leaf minute hand, needle seconds hand, 42 mm steel mesh (Milanese) bracelet built with the column-driven bracelet of pipeline/steps/watch_breitling_superoceanheritage42.py (strap.bracelet.columns = pieces chains with their own x tables: a polished end-link bar under each lug pair and the mesh to the alpha ends).

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 197 / bottoms y 775 px); no crown guards; top and bottom slope toward the bracelet

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (bezel_in..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip measured as the thr-60 silhouette in rotated strips (so the 3D hands cover the photographed ones); the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon mirrored about the axis (hour: triangle inside the arrow head, minute: leaf core; the seconds needle has no lume). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: fluted crown without guards (the crown rows of the silhouette are replaced by the mirrored left edge)

strap.note: strap.kind bracelet in the Heritage step copy: strap.bracelet.columns = chains of flat pieces, each with its own x table (x_mm, [|y|, left, right] piecewise linear per side) or, when absent, the strap outline of the silhouette (edge_from = first strap-wide row beyond the lug tops). bar = polished end link between the lugs (top y 209..250 px, bottom 721..763), mesh = Milanese mesh to the alpha ends (top y 105, bottom 918 px); pivot (511.2, 482.7), 11.4524 px/mm.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
